title: The Chemical smell in the lab
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：chemical　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chemical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the writer wrote of ① a chemical smell in the lab in the manuscript, and everybody in the study said at once that it was ② more chemical than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the writer, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the chemical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most chemical smell in the lab anybody in the study had ever seen, or so the manuscript for January 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too chemical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the reader who had come to help; the chemical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a chemical change in the soil, and said that no reader in his right mind would call it ⑥ as chemical as the change in the soil they had once had in the old study. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was chemical or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was ⑦ something chemical, and nothing besides. The reader from the next study called the whole plan ⑧ quite chemical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manuscript kept the names of the chemical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, in public, she wrote of another chemical smell in the lab in the same manuscript, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more chemical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most chemical change in the soil in the whole study, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the chemical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 化学（前置定语 a chemical smell in the lab：1976 年写作者在手稿里记下的那件化学的气味）
B. adj. 化学／化学作用（比较级 more chemical than：文中两处，一处比实验室的气味，一处比预想）
C. adj. 化学／化学作用（最高级 the most chemical：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 化学（表语 too chemical to do：母亲觉得它太化学，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 化学作用（前置定语 a chemical change in the soil：叔叔把整件事称作一桩化学作用的变化）
F. adj. 化学作用（同级比较 as chemical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩土壤的变化相比）
G. adj. 化学作用（后置定语 something chemical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 化学作用（受程度副词修饰 quite chemical：那位读者的评价）

items.q: a chemical smell in the lab
the most chemical smell in the lab anybody
a chemical change in the soil
The most chemical change in the soil in

answers.why: chemical 意为“化学”，1976 年写作者在手稿里记下的是“一件化学的气味”，此处作前置定语 a chemical smell in the lab。
chemical 意为“化学”，此处用比较级 more chemical than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
chemical 意为“化学”，手稿上 一月 那行字说它是书斋里最化学的一件，故用最高级 the most chemical smell in the lab。
chemical 意为“化学”，母亲认为这件东西“太化学了，谁也用不上”，too chemical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩化学作用的变化”，此处作前置定语 a chemical change in the soil。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩土壤的变化一样化学作用”，同级比较用 as chemical as。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，手稿上那半行字要的是“化学作用的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something chemical。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，邻书斋来的那位读者认为这套计划“相当化学作用”，quite 修饰原级 chemical。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要化学作用”，故用比较级 more chemical than。
chemical 意为“化学作用”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个书斋里最化学作用的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most chemical change in the soil。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，写作者在手稿里记下了一件化学的气味。（a chemical smell in the lab）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更化学。（more chemical than …）
母亲觉得它太化学，谁也用不上。（too chemical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩化学作用的变化。（a chemical change in the soil）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩土壤的变化一样化学作用。（as chemical as …）
到了 1983 年，手稿上只剩半行字：要的是一件化学作用的东西。（something chemical）
answers: In 1976 the writer wrote of a chemical smell in the lab in the manuscript.
Everybody said it was more chemical than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too chemical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a chemical change in the soil.
He said nobody would call it as chemical as the change in the soil they had once had.
By 1983 the manuscript asked for nothing but something chemical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 chemical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the writer wrote of a chemical smell in the lab in the manuscript, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most chemical smell in the lab in the study, or so the manuscript says.
My mother thought it too chemical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a chemical change in the soil, and nobody argued with him.
The reader from the next study called the plan quite chemical, and everybody laughed.
The chemical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
